text.p: Following are the main stories in Monday's Malaysian newspapers. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

-- A Cessna 172 aircraft used in the filming of the Tour de Langkawi bicycle race, crashed on Sunday, killing its pilot and the two cameramen on board. The incident occured in the northern Malaysian island of Langkawi.
-- The government will take steps to ensure civil servants improve efficiency said Prime Minister Mahathir Mohamad.
-- Berjaya Group Bhd has sold its entire 35.52 percent stake in Hospital Pantai Bhd to Mokhzani Mahathir, chief executive of Tongkah Holdings, and son of Prime Minister Mahathir.
-- Malaysian conglomerate Sime Darby has taken a 'look north' approach in acquiring Thailand's Morakot Industries.
-- The number of companies incorporated in Malaysia fell 0.22 percent in 1996, compared to a drop of 0.76 percent in 1995.
